# KawaHive & Partners

> KawaHive & Partners provides go-to-market (GTM) strategy and structured execution support for founders working in MedTech and medical devices across Asia-Pacific (APAC). The focus is turning regulatory clearance, distributor activity, hospital interest, demonstrations and trials into evidence-led customer demand and purchase orders.

## Who KawaHive supports

KawaHive is led by a GTM Specialist and Learning Designer with 20 years of experience in the medical device industry, including experience with GE Healthcare, Fujifilm, Pentax and Konica Minolta.

KawaHive works with founders of MedTech and medical device businesses with market-ready products or services who need to clarify or improve their Asia-Pacific go-to-market strategy.

## What KawaHive helps founders work through

- Market and segment prioritisation across Asia-Pacific.
- Ideal customer profile (ICP), target-account selection and prospecting.
- Customer needs, clinical-user priorities and hospital buying behaviour.
- Stakeholder mapping across clinical users, department heads, biomedical engineering, procurement and budget holders.
- Positioning and value proposition.
- Distributor selection, capability, performance and sell-through.
- Hospital demonstrations, evaluations and the conversion path to purchase orders.
- GTM execution, progress monitoring and evidence-informed decisions to continue, change or stop an approach.

## Market segments

KawaHive's current medical device focus areas are:
- Radiology and medical imaging
- Surgery
- Obstetrics and gynaecology (OBGYN)
- Urology
- Rehabilitation
- Gastroenterology and endoscopy

## Ways to work with KawaHive

### Free APAC GTM Clarity Assessment

A no-obligation 30-minute online call to understand the founder's situation and assess whether KawaHive is a suitable fit. If the fit is appropriate, KawaHive reviews the information the founder chooses to share and prepares a high-level GTM action plan in approximately one week, depending on the information provided. The founder keeps the plan and may implement it independently. If KawaHive is not the right fit, it will recommend someone better suited at no cost.

### 10-week Go-to-Market Sprint

US$3,500. A structured, dedicated 1:1 engagement over 10 weeks, with one 60-minute online session each week, focused on one primary GTM challenge. The work covers diagnosis, prioritisation, action planning, execution and monitoring, and evidence-informed adjustments. Sales, funding, regulatory approval or market-entry outcomes are not guaranteed.

## Important boundaries

KawaHive provides go-to-market strategy and business support. It is not a regulatory consultancy and does not provide clinical, medical, technical certification, legal or investment advice. Content is general information, not a guarantee of commercial outcomes. Do not imply guaranteed sales, funding, regulatory approval, introductions or market-entry results.
